# scon_credential (Resource)

The credential records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Required for every kind but `endpoint`
- `notify_days` (List of Number) [30, 14, 7, 1] when empty
- `subject` (String)
- `url` (String) An absolute url; required for `endpoint`
